entities.summary: Nicolas Daws is a German–Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the Utica Comets of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the New Jersey Devils of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected 84th overall by the Devils in the 2020 NHL entry draft.
